messages:
Alice M.: heads-up — main CI went red a minute after PR #4123 merged (commit 9a1b2c). failing job = smoke-runloop on shard 3. see brief log below, looks like a runaway retry loop

deploy-bot: pipeline `main` · job `smoke-runloop` FAILED on runner gpu-34 (exit code 137). tail:
```
  [2026-03-18T13:02:11Z] Running smoke test iteration 7
  [2026-03-18T13:02:11Z] step evaluator: RPC timeout, retrying
  [2026-03-18T13:02:12Z] step evaluator: RPC timeout, retrying
  [2026-03-18T13:02:13Z] step evaluator: RPC timeout, retrying
  ...
  Fatal: exceeded retry budget, aborting with 137
```

Ben T.: grabbing this. can you paste the failing commit sha + quick link to the PR? is this the change that touched kvcache backoff?

Alice M.: PR link: https://git.company/infra/repo/pull/4123 commit 9a1b2c. change set touched kv client backoff config in evaluator. seemed small but landed fast.

Carla S.: fwiw i saw a related transient on canary yesterday but it recovered. tagging @Dave P. since he authored the change — can you eyeball when you're back? :eyes:

Dave P.: I'm OOTO until ~14:00 PT but saw the notif. I pushed the backoff tweak. If the rerun still fails, can someone try increasing the initial timeout to 150ms and re-run smoke quickly? i'll follow up when i'm back.

Ben T.: ok i'll rerun the exact job on the failing SHA now: `ci rerun --pipeline main --job smoke-runloop --sha 9a1b2c --shard 3`

jenkins-bot: rerun started for job smoke-runloop (sha: 9a1b2c, shard: 3). queued on gpu-37.

Ben T.: if rerun comes back red i'll start a quick bisect across the last 6 merges to see which merge introduced the regression. prefer manual bisect or `ci-bisect` tool?

Alice M.: try `ci-bisect` if it's fast — we need to know whether to revert or patch. also please capture full tail logs and upload to the run artifacts.

jenkins-bot: rerun completed: SUCCESS on gpu-37. duration 2m14s. artifacts: https://ci.company/artifacts/9a1b2c/smoke-runloop/shard-3/

Ben T.: green on rerun. uploading logs now. looks like the original runner (gpu-34) hit OOM + docker restart loop, not purely RPC timeouts. suspect infra flake intersecting with backoff tweak.

Carla S.: thanks — i'll mark the canary alert as noise. Dave, given this, maybe we keep the backoff tweak but add a little more headroom and a circuit-breaker to avoid runaway retries.

Dave P.: agreed. i'll open a follow-up PR to add a max-retries cap + bump initial timeout. won't revert the merge.

Alice M.: nice triage. Ben, please leave the bisect on hold and close the thread when follow-up PR is opened. :thumbsup:

Ben T.: will do. closing for now, ping me if it reappears.
